address: St. Regis Hotel, Nation Towers, Corniche, Abu Dhabi
bio: As you’d expect from the name, you can find many a classic Tuscan dish here within the St. Regis hotel on the Corniche waterfront. Familiar favourites like spaghetti alle vongole mix with plenty of pizzas and a wide range of other dishes to form a menu with something for everyone. If you’re unsure of what to pick, the team are ready to recommend dishes worth trying – but do not miss the tiramisu. For the oenophiles, take your time looking over the wine list as you’ll find some gems on there.
